summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. Added 7 new pytest cases for the 2 new AI endpoints: POST /api/coach-chat (3 tests) and POST /api/exercise-estimate (4 tests). All 24/24 tests PASSED in 49s, including the original 17 regression tests (analyze-food, barcode-lookup, food/weight/water/activity log CRUD, food-search, parse-food-text, recipes CRUD, weekly-summary, water-log DELETE). Coach-chat returns topical pre-workout advice (mentions carbs/protein/snack), handles multi-turn history, and returns 400 on empty message. Exercise-estimate returns activity/met/calories_burned/intensity/note/duration_minutes, basketball 45m@75kg moderate produced calories in the expected 200-600 kcal range, invalid intensity 'extreme' correctly defaults to 'moderate', and 'hard' burns strictly more than 'easy' for cycling 30m@70kg. No mongo _id leakage detected.

minor.issue: Dead code: first loop over req.history[-6:] in coach_chat() does nothing (only sets unused locals); only the second loop over [-4:] is used. Cosmetic only - no functional impact.
BASE_URL uses hardcoded fallback 'https://vision-mobile-hub.preview.emergentagent.com'. Works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL matches, but per system guidelines tests should fail-fast on missing env.

action_items: (Optional) Remove dead first history loop in /app/backend/server.py coach_chat() lines 446-452 - the variables role/content are computed but never used.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py coach_chat: first history loop is no-op dead code (computes role/content then discards). Functional logic is in the second loop. Recommend deletion for clarity.
exercise_estimate has solid defensive fallbacks (MET fallback if AI returns 0, intensity validation, min weight/duration clamping). Good defensive design.
Both new endpoints correctly use _extract_json() helper and raise 502 on Gemini failures rather than leaking exceptions.
No MongoDB persistence in coach-chat or exercise-estimate - intentional (stateless AI calls), confirmed acceptable.
